sections.body: Healthy relationships (friends, family, partners) have respect, trust, honesty, equality and good communication. You can be yourself and spend time with others.
CONSENT is a clear, freely given, enthusiastic 'yes'. It can be withdrawn at any time. Silence, pressure or someone being drunk or asleep does NOT mean consent.
Warning signs of an unhealthy or abusive relationship: controlling who you see, checking your phone, jealousy presented as 'love', threats, put-downs, or pressure to do things you don't want to.
If you or someone you know is in an unhealthy relationship, talk to a trusted adult or a support service. It is never the victim's fault.

quiz.q: Which is a warning sign of an unhealthy relationship?
options: A partner who checks your phone and controls who you see
A partner who respects your friendships
hints: A friend who gets angry whenever you spend time with others is showing a controlling behaviour.
quiz.explain: Controlling behaviour, like checking your phone or limiting friendships, is a warning sign.

quiz.q: Someone said yes earlier but now says they want to stop. What does consent mean here?
options: Stop: consent can be withdrawn at any time
Continue, since they said yes before
hints: It can change at any moment.
If a friend agreed to lend you their bike but then changes their mind, you give it back.
quiz.explain: Consent can be withdrawn at any time, and that must be respected immediately.
